facts.text: The whispering gallery has tiled arches; people in opposite corners can hear each other speaking quietly.
The information booth in the Main Concourse has a four-faced clock.
It is a railway terminal at 89 East 42nd Street in Manhattan.
Oak leaf and acorn decorations reference the Vanderbilt family, who financed the terminal.

explanation: The whispering gallery, the information booth’s four-faced clock, and East 42nd Street all point to Grand Central Terminal.

facts.text: The park has a marble arch honoring George Washington.
Its fountain is a popular meeting place and is older than the arch.
The park has a tradition of chess playing.
It is in Manhattan, at Fifth Avenue, Waverly Place, West 4th Street and Macdougal Street.

explanation: The Washington Arch, the fountain, chess players, and the streets around the park identify Washington Square Park.
